name: to-yaml
to-yaml-types
to-yaml-element
to-toml
to-toml-array-of-tables
to-toml-missing-value
to-toml-missing-in-list
script:
set p to PlistNew {l:{1, missing value}}
try
PlistToTOML p
end try
PlistClose p

name: to-toml-not-a-table
script:
set p to PlistNew {1, 2}
try
PlistToTOML p
end try
PlistClose p

name: from-yaml
script:
set p to PlistFromYAML "name: Ann
country: no
n: 12
r: 1.5
t: true
nothing: null
tags: [a, b]
address:
  city: Paris"
PlistGet p
PlistClose p

name: from-yaml-dates
script:
set p to PlistFromYAML "utc: 2026-09-28T14:30:00Z
offset: 2026-09-28T10:30:00-04:00
quoted: \"2026-09-28\""
PlistToJSON p
PlistClose p

name: from-yaml-merge
script:
set p to PlistFromYAML "base: &b
  a: 1
  b: 2
derived:
  <<: *b
  b: 3"
PlistGet p
PlistClose p

name: from-yaml-pool
script:
set p to PlistFromYAML "a: 1" in pool "mtc-yaml"
GetPool p
PlistClose p

name: from-yaml-invalid
script:
try
PlistFromYAML "a: [1, 2"
end try

name: from-yaml-documents
script:
try
PlistFromYAML "a: 1
---
b: 2"
end try

name: from-toml
script:
set p to PlistFromTOML "# comment
name = \"Ann\"
n = 12
tags = [\"a\", \"b\"]
time = 14:30:00
[address]
city = \"Paris\""
PlistGet p
PlistClose p

name: from-toml-dates
script:
set p to PlistFromTOML "utc = 2026-09-28T14:30:00Z
offset = 2026-09-28T10:30:00-04:00"
PlistToJSON p
PlistClose p

name: from-toml-invalid
script:
try
PlistFromTOML "a = 1
a = 2"
end try

name: round-trip-toml
script:
set p to PlistNew {person:"Ann", tags:{"a", "b"}, address:{city:"Paris"}}
set q to PlistFromTOML (PlistToTOML p)
PlistEqual p to q
PlistClose q
PlistClose p

name: round-trip-yaml
script:
set p to PlistNew {person:"Ann", n:missing value, sample:{1, {k:"v"}, {"deep"}}}
set q to PlistFromYAML (PlistToYAML p)
PlistEqual p to q
PlistClose q
PlistClose p

name: file-json
script:
set p to PlistNew {person:"Ann", sample:{1, 2}}
PlistToJSON p in (POSIX file "$TMP/data.json")
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/data.json")
set q to PlistFromJSON (POSIX file "$TMP/data.json")
PlistEqual p to q
PlistClose q
PlistClose p

name: file-yaml
script:
set p to PlistNew {person:"Ann", sample:{1, 2}}
PlistToYAML p in (POSIX file "$TMP/data.yaml")
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/data.yaml")
set q to PlistFromYAML (POSIX file "$TMP/data.yaml")
PlistEqual p to q
PlistClose q
PlistClose p

name: file-toml
script:
set p to PlistNew {person:"Ann", sample:{1, 2}}
PlistToTOML p in (POSIX file "$TMP/data.toml")
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/data.toml")
set q to PlistFromTOML (POSIX file "$TMP/data.toml")
PlistEqual p to q
PlistClose q
PlistClose p

name: file-path-string
script:
set p to PlistNew {person:"Ann"}
PlistToTOML p in "$TMP/path.toml"
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/path.toml")
PlistClose p

name: file-missing
script:
try
PlistFromTOML (POSIX file "$TMP/nope.toml")
end try

name: file-text-is-json
script:
try
PlistFromJSON "$TMP/data.json"
end try
